steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Define the app name and the unique package name in app-meta.json and api_schema.json.

steps.title: Setup Gradle Environment
steps.description: Configure build.gradle to use Java 17 toolchain, target SDK 34, min SDK 21 and the correct AGP.

steps.title: Configure App Manifest
steps.description: Declare permissions, Launcher Activity (LoginActivity), and other activities with native Material theme styling.

steps.title: Create Asset Files
steps.description: Copy the app-meta.json into the main assets folder so the app_id can be loaded dynamically at runtime.

steps.title: Design Background Drawables and UI Resources
steps.description: Create custom styles, colors, and button/card backgrounds using XML shapes for a highly modern design.

steps.title: Build Authenticated UI Shell Layouts
steps.description: Design clean, user-friendly layouts for Register, Login, and OTP-based Forgot Password screens.

steps.title: Build Main Tracker and Form Layouts
steps.description: Build the main dashboard displaying real-time calculations (balance, income, expenses), dynamic list layout, adding transaction form layout, and monthly report layout.

steps.title: Develop Native HTTP Backend Client
steps.description: Create the BackendApi.java class to load app_id dynamically and handle asynchronous network requests for auth and custom transactions.

steps.title: Implement Offline Calculation models
steps.description: Create Transaction model classes and utility calculations to compute totals, balances, and categories locally.

steps.title: Implement Authenticaton & Forgot Password Controllers
steps.description: Code custom logic for LoginActivity, RegisterActivity, and ForgotPasswordActivity with standard error handling and secure local storage of JWT tokens.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard, Form, and Report Controllers
steps.description: Implement MainActivity, AddTransactionActivity, and ReportsActivity to execute complete client-side data calculation logic and secure CRUD execution.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker
steps.description: Run offline verification, code check, compatibility logic validation, and build standard APK outputs.
